title: Ultimate cat experience at Austin's cat cafe
includes: Toys are available to play with the cats
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Relax at our cozy cat café, home to 20+ adorable, adoptable rescue cats. Sip on coffee as you enjoy 30 or 70 minutes of cuddles, and playtime. All guests must be 6+ and have a paid ticket—no exceptions. The purr-fect spot to unwind or meet your future feline friend!
